src: non-default interior marker blocks inside framed tile regions, grouped by color
dst: same-color marker blocks sharing a marker row band or column band
path: for each marker color, connect the four corner blocks along the two horizontal and two vertical sides of their implied rectangle, crossing only background channel cells
trajectory: paint every background cell on each rectangle side with the marker color
transform: keep all framed tiles, default interiors, marker blocks, and off-path background unchanged
